use System.Math

binomial(upper: int, lower: int) -> bigint =>

            running * bigint(upper - lower + step) / bigint(step))

simplex(dimension: int) -> Pipe[bigint] =>

    let offset = Math.sqrt(9.0D * value * value - 1.0D / 27.0D) in
    let upper = Math.cbrt(3.0D * value + offset) in
    upper + 1.0D / (3.0D * upper) - 1.0D

pentatopic_root(value: double) -> double =>
    let inner = Math.sqrt(24.0D * value + 1.0D) in
    (Math.sqrt(5.0D + 4.0D * inner) - 3.0D) / 2.0D

let families = [(dimension = 2, name = "triangular"),
                (dimension = 3, name = "tetrahedral"),
                (dimension = 4, name = "pentatopic"),
                (dimension = 12, name = "12-simplex")]

families |> each(family => (

[7140L, 21408696L, 26728085384L, 14545501785001L]
